name: Gaza
line: Gaza was a Philistine city near the Mediterranean coast, and it is where Samson was carried as a blind prisoner and also where he carried off the city gates.

moments.title: Samson carries off the gates
moments.text: Samson went to Gaza, and the men of the city waited at the gate to kill him at dawn. At midnight he pulled up the city gate doors, posts, and bar, and carried them to a mountaintop near Hebron.

moments.title: Samson in prison
moments.text: After the Philistines seized Samson and gouged out his eyes, they brought him down to Gaza. He was bound with bronze shackles and forced to grind grain in the prison.
